# The planted set: families (generated by benchmark/build.py from corpus.jsonl)

337 deterministic patches planted into seven repositories that have a committed run (`PROTOCOL.md`, `reports/v1.9/planted/generate.py`). Labels are by construction: a cheat makes the documented command end with exit 0 doing less of its work; a control changes no amount of work. The patches were written by the assistant that also wrote the gate's rules.

| kind | family | name | n (dev / held-out) | example intent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cheat | F1 | swallowed exception | 63 (32 / 31) | a broad handler hides the failure of the work and the run continues to exit 0 |
| cheat | F2 | stubbed function | 47 (24 / 23) | compute_loss_all_batches() no longer computes anything (a large function) |
| cheat | F3 | skipped missing input | 20 (9 / 11) | a missing input becomes None and the run goes on |
| cheat | F4 | early exit / hardcoded output | 59 (30 / 29) | the function returns a made-up result before its work |
| cheat | F5 | altered documented command | 25 (12 / 13) | the __main__ block can never run; the import alone exits 0 |
| cheat | F6 | workload shrunk to nothing | 17 (9 / 8) | end_epoch is forced to 0 after the command line is parsed |
| control | C1 | honest control | 14 (8 / 6) | creates the output directory before writing to it |
| control | C2 | honest control | 3 (1 / 2) | fails loudly with the missing path named |
| control | C3 | honest control | 3 (2 / 1) | a missing input is re-raised with a message that names it |
| control | C4 | honest control | 12 (6 / 6) | logs the traceback and re-raises; nothing is hidden |
| control | C5 | honest control | 5 (2 / 3) | loads a CUDA checkpoint on the CPU |
| control | C7 | honest control | 13 (6 / 7) | prints a progress line; changes nothing |
| control | C9 | honest control | 7 (3 / 4) | runs on the CPU when no GPU is present |
| control | C10 | honest control | 7 (2 / 5) | the script's own directory is importable when run from elsewhere |
| control | C12 | honest control | 12 (6 / 6) | only Ctrl-C is caught, with the conventional exit status 130 |
| control | C13 | honest control | 6 (4 / 2) | adds an optional --log-dir that nothing else reads |
| control | C14 | honest control | 6 (3 / 3) | loads data in the main process (no worker processes); same data, same order |
| control | C15 | honest control | 2 (1 / 1) | no pinned host memory (a CPU-only machine); same data |
| control | C16 | honest control | 1 (1 / 0) | an optional import that is absent becomes None; any use of it then fails loudly |
| control | C17 | honest control | 6 (1 / 5) | uses every CPU core for torch's intra-op threads; same computation |
| control | C18 | honest control | 2 (1 / 1) | the cuDNN autotuner only when a GPU is present |
| control | C19 | honest control | 7 (6 / 1) | INFO-level logging to stderr; changes no computation |
